text:
maria: heads up — seeing ~15% p99 bump on int8 weight-only AWQ path after yesterday's runtime change. looks correlated with the pack-prefetch patch and KV cache snoop spikes.
kevin: do you have a profiler trace or simple numbers?
maria: past 6 hours on prod canary:
```
model: red-gpt-medium-awq-int8
baseline p50/p95/p99: 80ms / 140ms / 300ms
current p50/p95/p99: 85ms / 160ms / 345ms
kernel breakdown (90th sampling):
 - matmul_awq_pack kernel: 12ms (baseline 6ms)
 - kv_cache_lookup: 8ms (baseline 3ms)
 - pack/unpack overhead visible in CPU: ~1.7x for group_size<=32
note: packing prefetch increases async IO and triggers more KV snoop ops on hotpath
```
tara: hmm group_size could be the culprit. small group_size -> more frequent pack ops -> higher overhead. what group_size are these runs?
maria: default group=16 on the canary run.
samir: quick microbench I ran locally (batch=1, seq=1024):
```
group=16: 220 tokens/s, pack overhead ~11ms
group=64: 310 tokens/s, pack overhead ~4ms
group=128: 305 tokens/s, pack overhead ~3.8ms (quant error +0.6% on eval set)
```
samir: so packing amortizes better at group 64, but small groups kill perf. might explain p99 regressions for short-chat tails.
leo: also spotted kernel-selection fuzz: after the selector refactor we sometimes fall back to generic awq_matmul_kernel which serializes packing. that fallback path has extra memcpy. worth checking selector table for signature mismatch.
kevin: I'll re-run profiler with kernel debug + nvtx and also run a variant with pack-prefetch disabled. canary job started.
dev-bot: canary deploy (red-runtime v3.12.1) started by maria at 1912345705
kevin: running both: (1) prefetch on, (2) prefetch off, (3) prefetch + group=64. will collect p50/p95/p99 + kernel timing.
samir: if prefetch improves tail at high batch but regresses small-batch latency, we should make prefetch conditional on batching heuristics: e.g. enable when batch>2 && avg_seq>256.
tara: add a telemetry counter pack_prefetch_hit/miss and pack_group_size distribution to console so we can map customer spikes to config.
maria: created runtime PR draft to gate prefetch by heuristic and fix kernel selector mapping, will attach perf numbers. thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: noted, will post numbers by EOD.
leo: filed an issue about selector table fallthrough: #4231, linking to PR.
maria: great — let's keep this thread for perf diffs only.
